dialog.title: Share this lab
dialog.lead: Creates a public page with a picture of this lab and tables of its devices, VLANs and subnets. Anyone with the link can see it and open a copy.
dialog.privacy: The page contains this lab as it is now, including device settings. Do not put real passwords or private data in a lab you share.
dialog.linkedinHint: Only linkedin.com/in/… profile links are accepted.
dialog.longLink: Copy a long link instead (nothing is uploaded)
dialog.reused: This exact lab was already shared, so you get the same link.
dialog.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it yourself.
dialog.deleteHint: Only this browser can delete the page; keep using it if you may want to remove the page later.

errors.invalidRequest: Some fields are not valid. Check the title and the LinkedIn link.
errors.linkedinUrl: This is not a LinkedIn profile link (https://www.linkedin.com/in/…).
errors.invalidLab: This lab could not be shared because it is not a valid lab file.
errors.tooLarge: This lab is too large for a share page. Remove some devices or use “Export lab file”.
errors.notFound: This share page does not exist or was deleted.
errors.forbidden: Only the browser that created this page can delete it.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests from your connection. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: The share service is not reachable right now. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

page.openCopy: Open a copy in the lab
page.openFailed: The copy could not be saved in this browser.
page.deleteConfirm: Delete this share page? The link stops working for everyone.
page.invalidLab: The shared lab could not be read.
page.noVlans: No VLANs are configured on the switches.
page.noSubnets: No IPv4 addresses are configured yet.
